title: Additional-Test Processing Amount on Cancelled Genetic Accessions
content:
A cancelled Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class that carries more than one test has an amount added to its genetic cancellation handling fee for the additional processing.

Tests are counted from the ordered charge lines and the accepted add-on lines of the class's test numbers that have not been credited.

| Tests standing on the accession | Added to the handling fee |
|---|---|
| Three or more | 20.00 |
| Exactly two | 10.00 |
| One | nothing |

**Clause.** When three or more tests stand on the accession, 20.00 is added to the handling fee for the additional processing. When exactly two such tests stand, 10.00 is added to the handling fee. A single test adds nothing.

**Cases (hypothetical).**

- An ordered Expanded Carrier Screen and an accepted add-on Cystic Fibrosis Carrier Screen, neither credited: two tests, 10.00 added.
- Three ordered tests, one of them credited: two tests stand, 10.00 added.
- One ordered test: nothing added.
